---
name: "Develop Product Idea"
description: "Start or resume adaptive product development from a raw idea or existing evidence. Routes to only the discovery, research, synthesis, specification, red-team, or revision work needed next."
argument-hint: "Describe your rough idea, problem, desired outcome, or ask to continue"
agent: "Product Orchestrator"
---

Start or resume the [Product Development Orchestration](../skills/product-development-orchestration/SKILL.md) workflow using the user's message, current artifacts, and equivalent source material.

Treat the idea as an initial framing, not an approved product or solution. Do not assume it must become software, an app, website, SaaS, AI product, or any other digital solution.

Choose only the next action justified by the current decision. Do not require a missing workflow artifact when existing inputs provide equivalent context. Ask about consequential user decisions; otherwise proceed and label uncertainty. The target is a defensible decision or specification, not completion of every stage.
